answer_4.quote: We randomly select 500 samples and use human evaluation (with three experienced researchers who are not involved in this work ...) to measure the counterfactual data generated by GPT-3.5-turbo.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to verify the grammar of the generated sentence, whether the stance label matches the intended stance, and whether the sample follows the provided generation instructions, responding with a binary "yes" or "no" for each criterion.
